verdict.rationale: Docs mention running agents step-by-step (useful for tasks taking days) and replaying/inspecting memory, plus push_to_hub/from_hub for sharing agent configs, which hints at some state persistence but never describes checkpointing state to survive a crash and resuming exactly where it left off. Missing for 10: explicit crash-recovery/resume API, persistent state serialization on failure, and any hands-on evidence of successful resume-after-crash.
